blocks.text: Lakeshore four-store stock path, systems design

This is the working cut for LSH-SYS-2022-031 on December 15, 2022. Luis Ortega asked for a written bound after the current path (Four Woo sites, four POS ledgers, no join Luis trusts) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Luis Ortega, Cole Brennan, and Mara Singh. Primary host ops.lakeshore.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on one pooled warehouse bin, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Per-store on-hand. No shared bin. Woo is a projection. POS is source. React admin reads the API, does not write Woo. I am not restating a hallway yes. one pooled warehouse bin is out because Cole in Michigan City would sell Elkhart's last 12 spades. Luis will not pool. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at stores=4, spades=12, woo=4, pos=4, weeks=11, sku=18.4k, oversell=8.1, hops=3. Sibling tickets LSH-4510 and LSH-RB-2023-008. I will not reopen one pooled warehouse bin in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Cole Brennan is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Mara Singh owns a leftover that is easy to skip: woo-prod.lakeshore.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (27): refuse on one pooled warehouse bin, lock is per-store qty, POS source, Woo projection, API in the middle. I will not hide a product change inside a 'quick align' on LSH-4510.
Elkhart is not a warehouse for Michigan City. If we treat them as one bin, we will oversell both.

What a skeptical user would try first on ops.lakeshore.internal: the path Luis Ortega actually has, not a desktop demo. Metric I will argue is time-to-useful, not a vanity QPS. If we cannot show that path on pos-01.lakeshore.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Michael Gilfilian will not accept a laptop screenshot as that proof.
